coverage.main: Read all fifteen pages of arXiv 2011.14779v2 (CVPR 2021 header): Sections 1-7, Algorithm 1, Tables 1-3, Figures 1-5 and Appendices A-D (surrogate-dataset study with Table 4, logit recovery, synthetic-image examples, justification of Hypothesis 1).
coverage.supplement: Appendices are embedded in the arXiv PDF and read. The CVF version was not retrieved.
coverage.excluded_results: All results measure model-extraction fidelity: extracted-student accuracy and normalized accuracy (Tables 1 and 4), query budgets (Table 2), logit-recovery error (Table 3) and ablation figures. Adversarial examples and zeroth-order gradient estimation are discussed only as related techniques; no crafted adversarial example is transferred between models.

f1.evidence: Victim and student clean accuracies are reported for the extraction task, but there is no transferred-attack evaluation to which the field applies.

f3.evidence: No source-to-target adversarial transfer is evaluated.

f4.evidence: Reported quantities are extraction accuracies and query counts.

f5.evidence: The finite-difference step epsilon is a gradient-estimation parameter, not an adversarial perturbation budget.

f6.evidence: The paper links extraction code and models (github.com/cake-lab/datafree-model-extraction); with no transfer configuration this is neither a transfer recomputability success nor a failure.

artifact_checks.result: Downloaded and hashed v2; recorded the paper-linked extraction repository without evaluating it as a transfer artifact.

bounds_exclusion.reason: No adversarial transfer misclassification rate is reported.

limitations: Retained in the frozen corpus with non-applicability reasons; model-extraction fidelity is not an adversarial transfer outcome.
